sentences.en: After the show's nine year run, like other child stars, Coleman found it difficult to get out of the acting pigeon hole Diff'rent Strokes put him in.

sentences.en: A push up style bathing suit can look great on any type of body, so don't feel the need to pigeon-hole this style.
